verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair privacy question for an AI assistant SaaS like Lindy, so the axis applies. The pack never documents user-configurable retention periods or a way to delete data. The security page covers compliance, encryption, and no-training; the Slack context-lookback command and the Files explorer are adjacent features, not retention or deletion controls.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
